summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of the three targeted fixes on live auction 'antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-ZcBz'. All assertions passed: (1) Go Live is stable — LIVE badge appeared <5s and held for the entire 20s stability window (10/10 samples live=true, err=empty) with no 'Could not start video source' text; (2) Viewer #liveVideo attaches (rs=4, 320x180, not paused) and the fullscreen #fs-btn is visible (36x36, display:flex) and clicking it throws no JS/page error; (3) Mobile 390x844 buyer sees data-testid='mobile-quick-row' with 4 chips visible in sticky bottom bar, clicking mobile-quick-0 (+240 ₺ → 23.280 ₺) populates data-testid='mobile-bid-input' with 23280 (captured at t=50ms), submitBidMobile() runs, input clears, and the bid is accepted (Güncel Teklif = 23.280 ₺ shown; min_bid placeholder advances to 'Min: 23.520 ₺'). No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=390=innerWidth). Regression: homepage scrolled ~1500px → click first auction card → detail opens at top (scrollTop 0/0, scrollY 0). stream-seller-strip visible on desktop (921x63) and mobile (372x113). Auction left ACTIVE — no 'Sat' clicked.
critical_code_review_comments: Broadcast.vue single-camera-acquire fix confirmed working: no NotReadableError, no self-disconnect within 20s, broadcast-error stayed empty across 10 samples.
Fullscreen button #fs-btn on Auctions/Show.vue renders and is clickable when live; handler executes without page errors (fullscreen API itself may be blocked in automation — expected).

Mobile quickBidMobile(val) writes to #bid-input-mobile then calls window.submitBidMobile(); submission succeeded end-to-end and updated the current bid — good UX. Input clears after submit which is why post-submit read shows empty; captured value at 50ms confirms numeric write.
seed_data_creation: One mobile bid placed as buyer during quick-bid test: 23.280 ₺ on auction 'antika-masa-saati-ve-vazo-seti-ZcBz'. No sale performed; auction remains ACTIVE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The mobile quick-bid input APPEARS empty on post-click read because submitBidMobile() clears it after a successful bid; to verify write, sample input.value at ~50ms after click (before submit resolves) or watch for the placeholder/min_bid update. Confirmed testids: mobile-quick-row, mobile-quick-{0..2}, mobile-bid-input, mobile-bid-submit, bid-amount-input, bid-submit-btn. Chips array has 3 entries (indexes 0-2) — quick-3 does not exist on this auction. Broadcast is stable with fake media + granted camera/mic permissions on the preview origin.

feat3_mobile_quick_bid.submission_result: ACCEPTED — new highest bid = 23.280 ₺; next min advanced to 23.520 ₺

rca of the issue: Not applicable — all three fixes verified working. Prior double-getUserMedia in Broadcast.vue goLive would race LiveKit's own camera acquisition on the same device and trigger NotReadableError → disconnect; current implementation acquires camera once (release preview + 350ms delay before LiveKit takes over) and is stable for the full 20s observation window.
